This is tally visit 1.
On visit 1 tally round 1. On visit 2 tally only the deliberation ballots, not stale round-1 votes. A null ballot is a missing seat; the runner renders it as an empty ballot section. Missing deliberation on visit 1 is expected. Quorum is 2 of 3 seats. Count votes, not confidence. Only the skeptic may veto, and only for a concrete safety or data-loss issue it can point to. A veto: yes from the skeptic blocks and you may not override it. Majority approve means approved; majority block or no quorum means blocked. Otherwise choose split, allowed only on visit 1. On visit 2 you must choose approved or blocked; if there is still no majority approve, choose blocked.

Include the question, outcome, each ballot verbatim with its seat and round, your reasoning, and conditions. Mark missing seats explicitly. Do not change code or any other files. Return decision as one paragraph explaining the outcome and why.
